about: Every page self-check that does not pass under tools/page-selfchecks/run.mjs (headless Chromium, client/ served statically, the sample book on the desk, 1920x1080), with the reason as far as it is known. An entry is a red that is stated, never a pass. 'verified' says what was actually checked; where it says 'not verified', nobody has confirmed the reason. An entry marked 'sometimes' has been seen to pass on one run and not on the next.
measured: 2026-11-22, three runs of 494 checks: 487 or 488 passed each time

checks.why: The harness serves client/ statically; there is no app server to answer /api/health, /help and the other pages. The check's own message says so.
checks.verified: Read from the check's message, three runs. Not run against a real server here.

checks.why: Its service-worker conditions (the versioned shell cached with the studio in it; the served worker's bytes) do not hold under the static host.
checks.verified: Not verified on the real server or in an installed window.

checks.why: Expects the wording for a browser with element full screen; headless Chromium does not report one.
checks.verified: Not verified in a real window.

checks.why: Its fill-the-window steps do not complete in headless Chromium.
checks.verified: Not verified in a real window. Fails at 1280x720 and at 1920x1080.

checks.why: Its print-view case, a paragraph moved on with its margin notes, did not occur at this window size, so that part went unexercised. The check reports that as not passing rather than assume it.
checks.verified: Not verified at any size where the case occurs.

checks.why: The sample book's Epilogue has no painting yet: 16 of its 17 body sections carry their pair.
checks.verified: Observed, three runs. It is the sample's content, not code.

checks.why: Reads the sound's volume while it is still fading in: 0.424 of 0.7 on the runs that did not pass, 0.7 of 0.7 on the one that did. The outcome follows how fast the machine ran the check.
checks.verified: Seen not passing on two of three runs and passing on one. Whether the check should wait for the fade to end was not decided.

alsoSeen: At 1280x720 three more do not pass, all of them measuring the old studio page's own layout: zen.calm.manuscript-only (the text box runs under the bottom controls), editor.toolbar.layout (the toolbar wraps to four rows with a group split across them) and zen.controls.no-overlap. At 1920x1080 all three passed on three runs. Whether the 2.0 studio has the same layout at that size was not checked.
zen.sound.files-decode did not pass when the sound files were served as application/octet-stream and passed on three runs when served as audio/mpeg, as this runner serves them.

With no book on the desk about twenty more do not pass: they build an EPUB from the open book and the validator rightly asks for a title and an author. The runner loads the sample book first for that reason.
